explanation: Only the GO step can be nonzero, and only when the agent chooses a2 during a losing streak on a2, mostly in the second half of the episode. It builds up over consecutive unrewarded a2 trials, especially ones that went rare to S1: about 2-3 after the first loss, 7-9 after the second and 10 after the third or later; it falls to 0-1 on the first GO after a reward, and it is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and whenever a1 is chosen.
